name: Customer Operations
summary: Prepare grounded customer-request responses with governed context lookup and mandatory human approval.
audience: Mid-market service, account, and operations teams

requiredConnections.minimumScope: Read only the customer identity, case, and service fields required by the process

handoffChecks.description: Confirm the authoritative customer identifier and escalation categories.
Connect customer_record_lookup to a fixed, read-only provider adapter.
Replace example evaluation facts with customer-approved cases.
Run the release gate and begin in shadow or approval mode.
Record a 30-day value target before publication.
